phase: validation of the frozen TAP-E1 Intent Understanding Layer with a real LLM interpreter
the_only_variable_under_study: the interpretation engine (deterministic stand-in -> real LLM). Schema, deterministic extraction, provenance, ambiguity, conflict, clarification, metrics, and leakage controls are imported UNCHANGED from TAP-E1.
honesty_notes: New, independently authored synthetic corpus (v1.1); no TAP-E1 prompt reused or mutated.

No Anthropic API key is available in this environment, so the real-model outputs were produced by the IN-SESSION agent model (claude-opus-4-8) acting as the interpreter and cached. This is a real LLM interpreting, but NOT an independent API run.
The SAME model authored the corpus and interpreted it (author==interpreter confound). This is the single largest limitation and bounds the claim.
Interpretations were produced from the prompt (+ conversation/metadata) only; gold was never consulted at inference.
Token counts are ~4-chars/token estimates; latency is not measured on the agent path (the API path measures it).

corpus_target_vs_actual.reason: Reduced below target because each real-model interpretation was produced by hand by the in-session agent (no API), so coverage was scoped for tractability and quality. Real-model outputs were produced for the full eval/adversarial/negative splits plus a 20-case dev sample used for config selection.

config_selection_rule: argmax on the DEV split (cases with cached model output) of a documented weighted criterion; simplest baseline wins ties; the hidden eval set is NEVER used for selection.

gates.rationale: LLM must not regress on constraint preservation vs deterministic TAP-E1 (V4)
LLM must improve overall intent fidelity
unsupported assumptions must remain acceptably low
LLM severe failures must not exceed deterministic TAP-E1 (V4)
no material ambiguity may be silently resolved

gate_application: Gates applied to the DEV-selected baseline on the HIDDEN eval split, comparing against the deterministic TAP-E1 V4 interpreter on the same case set. Fixed before hidden scoring.

verdict_rule.PASS_WITH_LIMITED_CLAIM: no safety gate fails AND the fidelity-improvement gate passes (capped below PASS by the synthetic corpus, in-session model, and author==interpreter confound)
verdict_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: no safety gate fails but fidelity does not improve -> deterministic remains the safer default
verdict_rule.FAIL: any safety gate fails -> deterministic remains safer

metric_corrections: invented_action made paraphrase-invariant (abstractive interpreter); discovered on DEV.
material-ambiguity flag credits PARTIALLY_RESOLVED + explicit stated_assumption as 'represented'.
Both applied uniformly to all baselines and the deterministic interpreter; TAP-E1 metrics.py is not modified (corrections live in metrics_e11.py).
